Visualize fitted miQC components and posterior classifications

Source: R/check_miQC_components.R
check_miQC_components.Rd

Creates diagnostic scatter plots of mitochondrial percentage versus the complexity metric used in run_miQCadj(), including keep/discard classifications based on a chosen posterior cutoff, and optionally, fitted mixture component aggregation lines.

Usage

check_miQC_components(
  flexmix_list,
  sample_name = NULL,
  use_median_columns = FALSE,
  x_values = "model_column",
  posterior_cutoff = 0.75,
  point_size = 1,
  point_alpha = 0.8,
  color_lines = c(discard = "black", keep = "blue"),
  color_points = c(discard = "dimgrey", keep = "cornflowerblue"),
  combine_plots = TRUE
)

Arguments

flexmix_list

The list object returned by run_miQCadj() with required flexmix_data and model_info slots.

sample_name

Character scalar, optional. Sample name to be used for the plots. A prefix paste0(sample_name, ": ") will either be used for each plot, if combine_plots=FALSE, or for the global plot only, if combine_plots=TRUE. Defaults to NULL.

use_median_columns

Logical Scalar. Whether component classification based on aggregated low-quality mitochondrial should be used. Only possible, if median-related component selection columns "_median" are available in the flexmix_data data frame. Defaults to FALSE.

x_values

Character Scalar. Available options include model_column (default) or complexity_column. Will return identical plots for linear, spline, polynomial, and polynomial_raw models. For one-dimensional models model_column will return plots with decreasing mitochondrial percentage using ranked cell indices in the x-axis. If complexity_column had been provided to run_miQCadj() values from complexity_column can be used as x_values.

posterior_cutoff

Numeric Scalar between 0 and 1. Cutoff used for keep/discard classification. Defaults to 0.75.

point_size

Non-negative Numeric Scalar. Point size used for scatter plots. Defaults to 1.

point_alpha

Non-negative Numeric Scalar. Transparency used for scatter plots. Defaults to 0.8.

color_lines

Named character vector, optional. Specifying the colors for keep and discard classifications, will plot lines for keep/discard classification curves based on aggregated medians. Defaults to c(discard = "black", keep = "blue").

color_points

Named character vector for keep/discard point color values with names c("discard", "keep"). Defaults to c(discard = "dimgrey", keep = "cornflowerblue").

combine_plots

Logical Scalar. Whether the list of plots should be combined into a 2-column-grid using patchwork. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

If combine_plots=FALSE named list of ggplot objects:

  • classificationPlot with miQC classification based on posterior probability thresholds..

  • probabilityPlot with miQC probability for each cell being related to low-quality classification.

If combine_plots=TRUE (default) the items will be combined into a 1x2-grid using patchwork with sample_name being used for the global title, only.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fm <- run_miQCadj(input_obj = obj)

plots <- check_miQC_components(
  flexmix_list = fm,
  sample_name = "Sample")

# show combined plot grid
print(plots)
} # }
